set.pl: Williams Station (Alamo Twp), about 12 mi west of Kalamazoo
pinev: Township-level: near Williams Station, Alamo Twp, from the 1907 accounts (about 5 km).

tw-mi-kalamazoo-van-arsdale-1907.st: He died March 1907 in a tenant house near Williams Station, 12 mi west of Kalamazoo, where he had once owned 200 acres. Local papers stress he died poor (ruined by signing friends' notes); only one dispatch tells of hidden gold and 500 diggers, so treat it as doubtful.
